title: Pomp in Paradise | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Incredible 6 suite pet friendly estate with a private pool and elevator, 1 minute to two different beach accesses, and 4-minutes to Rosemary Beach.
description_expanded: Pomp in Paradise Loaded luxury retreat with panoramic Gulf views, private pool, outdoor living spaces, multiple living rooms, bikes, and 1 minute to the beach access. Home Introduction Guests with discerning tastes will love Pomp in Paradise , a 6 bedroom/6 full and 2 half bath luxury estate with incredible private outdoor spaces, panoramic Gulf views, high-end amenities, and only 1 minute to the Wall Street Beach Access. Impress your family and friends with special services like a catered beach bonfire, a private chef, grocery delivery, and guided boat tours. Home Highlights • Panoramic Gulf Views - breathtaking views from the wrap-around 2nd floor furnished balcony and the deluxe rooftop outdoor lounge. • Private Pool - enjoy year-round outdoor fun in the fenced-in backyard with a private pool and fire pit with conversation seating. Pool heating included for arrivals October - April. • Pet Friendly - Pre-approval and payment of a non-refundable pet fee required for up to 2 dogs, 60 pounds or less. A pet station is available in the fenced-in yard. • 6 Taxi Bikes - the recommended way to explore Inlet Beach and nearby Rosemary Beach • Outdoor Living - Gulf facing rooftop lounge, 2nd floor balcony with summer kitchen, lounge with TV and outdoor dining, deluxe fire pit with conversation seating, and plenty of space to lounge poolside. • Outdoor Shower and Outdoor Grill • Private Residential Elevator - travels to floors 1 through 3 • Gourmet Kitchen - arranged with high-end appliances like Thermador and Keurig. A large pantry and wet bar also available • Sleeping for 16 Guests in 6 Bedrooms - 4 King suites and 2 bunk rooms • Laundry Room on 1st and 2nd floor • Smart TVs and WIFI • Driveway parking for up to 6 vehicles , but we do not recommend more than 4 vehicles. There is limited turn-around space, and you may need to back out your vehicle. • Complete Clean Linen Program - All linens laundered after every stay Location Perks • 1 minute bike ride to the Wall Street Beach Access. Beach service available. • 1 minute bike ride to Inlet Beach Regional Beach Access. Seasonal lifeguards, beach service, parking, outdoor showers, restrooms, and beach bonfires available at this location • 4-minute bike ride to the middle of Rosemary Beach. Lots of shopping and dining options • 10-minute stroll to 30Avenues with upscale shopping, entertainment, and casual plus fine dining options • 2 miles to the largest Publix in the country. Curbside pick-up and delivery available through Instacart Know Before You Go • A mid-stay clean is required for bookings 10+ days (included in rate) • Up to 2 dogs, 60 pounds or less allowed with prior approval from Exclusive 30A and payment of a non-refundable pet fee • Concierge available for add-ons like eBikes, beach bonfires, beach chair and umbrella setup, and chef services ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
